<quote by="Proposed: Temeschwar, Seconded: Kallavesa">To construct a prosperous counting house in Temeschwar. This will add 14 crowns to the Virtue Fund per summit. Self funded

==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in [[Temeschwar]]
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Forwards and Rewards]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Autumn 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 5 wains of weirwood
* 5 wains of white granite
* 30 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Temeschwar_Counting_House}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Rewarding|Virtue Fund]] will gain an additional 14 crowns each season from donations to [[Temeschwar#The_Bloodied_Rose|the Bloodied Rose]] in Temeschwar, starting at the Summer Solstice 388YE
